import os
import sqlite3
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.api import handle_import
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import add_contact, import_contacts


def rejects(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("Expected ValueError")


for isolation_level in ("", None):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
    initialize(c)
    add_contact(c, "a@b", "Alice")
    assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [
        {"email": " A@B ", "name": " Alice "},
        {"email": " C@D ", "name": " Carol "},
    ]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}
    original = list_contacts(c)
    assert original == [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")]
    assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
    for row in (None, [], {}, {"email": "x@y", "name": "X", "extra": 1},
                {"email": 1, "name": "X"}, {"email": "x@y", "name": None},
                {"email": "x@@y", "name": "X"}, {"email": "@y", "name": "X"},
                {"email": "x@", "name": "X"}, {"email": "x @y", "name": "X"},
                {"email": "x@y", "name": "  "}):
        rejects(lambda: import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b", "name": "Changed"}, row]))
        assert list_contacts(c) == original
    rejects(lambda: import_contacts(c, [
        {"email": "X@Y", "name": "X"}, {"email": " x@y ", "name": "Y"}]))
    for payload in (None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}},
                    {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}):
        rejects(lambda: handle_import(c, payload))
    c.execute("""CREATE TRIGGER fail_import BEFORE INSERT ON contacts
                 WHEN NEW.email = 'fail@test'
                 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'failure'); END""")
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b", "name": "Changed"},
                            {"email": "new@test", "name": "New"},
                            {"email": "fail@test", "name": "Fail"}])
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Expected database failure")
    assert list_contacts(c) == original
    assert not c.in_transaction
    c.close()
